description.value:
A grafted sac low in the gut that voids a cloud on command. 1 action, 3/day: a 10-foot emanation of concealing haze (15-foot cone underwater) until the start of your next turn — creatures inside are concealed from those outside and vice versa. You may Step or Stride 10 feet as part of the same action.

Rider: A bad enough scare sets it off. On a failed save against fear the cloud goes up around you whether you wanted it or not.

cinderfall.incomplete: The whole ability is a limited-use (3/day) activated concealment cloud plus a free Step/Stride -- a limited-use area effect needs a granted Action item, not a rule element (same class of gap as Ink-Bladder's sibling activated-ability cards throughout this pass).
